_units: mu0_kappa and mu0_chi in T (divide by mu0 to get A/m), tau_c and tau_e in s, alpha dimensionless (weights summing to 1).
_source: Values transcribed from application_S_Chain.py and application_CS_Chain.py. The 15-cell chain is Table 1 of Dular et al., SuST 38 035017 (2025), with chi_11 corrected from 1.50 T to 0.75 T.

S.label: 1 cell
S.description: The simplest possible model: a single cell. It reproduces the major loop only.

S.label: 4 cells
S.description: Four cells with evenly spaced thresholds. Minor loops appear, with visible corners.

S.label: 6 cells
S.description: Six cells, as identified in the paper for the rate-independent strand response. Smoother minor loops.

CS.label: 1 cell
CS.description: A single composite cell: hysteresis, coupling currents and eddy currents in their simplest form.

CS.label: 2 cells
CS.description: Two composite cells with different time constants.

CS.label: 5 cells
CS.description: Five composite cells: a compact model of a multifilamentary strand.

CS.label: 7 cells
CS.description: Seven composite cells, built on the 6-cell rate-independent model.

CS.label: 15 cells (paper)
CS.description: The 15-cell chain of the paper (Table 1), accurate over a wide range of field amplitudes and frequencies.
